title: Endless Shrimp Didn't Sink Red Lobster
summary: In 2023, Red Lobster made all-you-can-eat shrimp a permanent $20 deal, lost $11 million on it in one quarter, and filed for bankruptcy less than a year later. Everyone blamed the shrimp. But the bankruptcy filing tells a longer story: a 2014 sale in which the restaurants' buildings were sold and rented back, rent rising 2% a year, 30% fewer customers since 2019, and an owner that was also its shrimp supplier. We follow the timeline from Lakeland, Florida, in 1968 to the comeback attempt of 2026. Allegations come from the bankruptcy filing and a 2026 lawsuit; Thai Union has called them meritless.
